summary.text: Karen Gerrish is the Republican candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 144 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing unenrolled candidate Corinna Cole.
She previously represented District 20 in the Maine House of Representatives from 2014 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Gerrish assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 2, 2014, and left office on December 4, 2018, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her profession as educator.
She served on the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee in both the 2015 and 2017 legislative sessions.
Ballotpedia notes that she did not run for re-election to District 20 in 2018.
